observed.front: Apr2019 Street View (n93I, h41; ref 1147-lot, ~23 m; two-anchor camera fit h45 fov 115): long greige row, a yellow door (kept on the module unit-2 door of the long section through the kit pale-door role), brown doors, beige walled courts with ochre caps. Doors and courts follow the module: the photographed yellow-door court starts about 2 m nearer the yellow door than the module places it (disclosed).
observed.rear: Mar2025 (HWEr, h204; ref 1147-rear, ~54 m from Bayside, medium): long row with doors behind a flat carport that may belong to a Bayside row (not modeled); rear yard doors on pads follow the module.

study_notes.eave: Wall top 7.806 = frozen flat base 2.506 + 5.3 m from dated photo proportions (production_inference); source height 6 m retained as identity only
study_notes.limits: Fences, vent pipes, post bands, carport-top finish (shared canopy uses the roof material), finish materials, site and decals parked for later levels. No recognition or stage acceptance claim.
